summary: Tested newly added authentication system (email/password register+login, Google OAuth redirect, onboarding, profile modal, logout, admin auto-assignment) plus full regression of pre-existing app (ClinicFlow, SuperSummary) now gated behind auth. 11/11 backend pytest cases passed. All Playwright UI flows passed: signup -> onboarding -> home; login with wrong password shows error; duplicate email signup shows error (no crash); correct login skips onboarding when profile complete; profile modal shows real name/email/profession/mobile; ADMIN badge correctly shown for adityasonofashok@gmail.com; logout returns to login screen; logged-out users are fully gated (see login screen, not app); Google sign-in button correctly redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<frontend_url> (matches expected format exactly). Regression: ClinicFlow and SuperSummary both load and function correctly post-auth with no console errors related to the app itself (only expected 401/400s from intentional negative-path testing).
action_items: Clean up test accounts in MongoDB 'users'/'sessions' collections created during this test pass (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md for full list) - most importantly delete the adityasonofashok@gmail.com test account (password TestAdminPass123) that was created solely to verify admin auto-assignment, so the real user can claim their account.
No code bugs found - no fixes needed at this time.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py is clean, uses async/await correctly for all DB ops, bcrypt for password hashing, proper 400/401/403 status codes, Pydantic validation on all request models, and correctly excludes password_hash/_id from all responses via UserPublic model + {'_id': 0} projections. No issues found.

AuthContext.jsx/AuthScreens.jsx: loginWithGoogle() correctly avoids hardcoding fallback URLs per the inline warning comment; verified live that clicking google-signin-btn redirects exactly to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin> as expected by the review request.

Minor observation (not a bug): AuthGate treats missing profession OR missing mobile_number as 'needs onboarding' - this is correct per spec, but note the onboarding-mobile-input validation is client-side only (min length 10 chars, no format/country-code validation) - acceptable for MVP phase 1.
Session cookie uses secure=True + samesite=none which requires HTTPS (correctly served via the preview HTTPS domain) - confirmed working, no cross-origin cookie issues observed during testing.
test_credentials: See /app/memory/test_credentials.md - test users with TEST_/testuser_ prefixes plus one adityasonofashok@gmail.com test admin account (password TestAdminPass123) that needs main-agent cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Multiple throwaway signup accounts created via both pytest and Playwright to exercise register/login/onboarding/profile/admin flows - all documented in test_credentials.md for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth system (Phase 1: email/password + Google OAuth + onboarding + admin auto-assign) is fully working end-to-end, both backend and frontend, no bugs found. Mobile-OTP-login was intentionally NOT tested/flagged as it's explicitly out of scope per problem statement (pending Twilio decision). Future testing agents should clean up leftover TEST_/testuser_*/adityasonofashok@gmail.com accounts in Mongo before further admin-feature testing (admin dashboard etc. are future phases, out of scope this pass).
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found - this was a clean regression + new feature pass with zero defects identified in either backend auth.py logic or frontend AuthContext/AuthScreens/AuthGate/ProfileModal integration.
